brief.name: Tampines Verge
brief.industry: Singapore HDB Build-To-Order (BTO) launch microsite — flat types, pricing, amenities, balloting timeline, and an eligibility checker
brief.audience: Singaporean first-time couples and families across Chinese, Malay, Indian and Eurasian communities; practical, mobile-first, time-pressed during a launch window.
brief.tone: clear, reassuring, civic, modern, inclusive, no-nonsense
brief.references: HDB / GovTech / Singpass design system, gov.sg, DBS and Singtel for clean trust
brief.context: Clean multicultural Singapore register — neutral modern base, an optional language toggle (EN / 中文 / Melayu / தமிழ்), balanced imagery that reflects CMIO without favouring one community. Sections: estate overview, flat types & indicative pricing (S$), amenities & connectivity (MRT), an eligibility checker, balloting timeline, and FAQ. PayNow-era clarity; WCAG AA; mobile-first.
brief.avoid: Picking one community's ornament to represent 'Singapore'. Hype or marketing tone for a civic service. Cluttered layouts. English-only when the audience is multilingual. Tiny touch targets.
